name: gaia_validation
notes: SPHEREx-only engine motions (find_motion via pipeline.analyse_frames, no archival refit) compared with Gaia DR3 proper motions; single exposures, not stacks.
Fields are 0.2 deg as the website asks for them; the engine sees the oversized raw cutout (cutout_request size), about 0.30 deg on a side.

Gaia 2016.0 positions are moved to each pass's date with Gaia's proper motion. A track is matched to the Gaia star (G <= 19.5) found in the most passes, ties going to the brightest, within max(4.5", 3 x the pass position error) and at most 9.0".

truth: static = Gaia total PM < 0.05"/yr with both components known to 0.01"/yr; real_mover = Gaia PM > 0.5"/yr and > 3 x the SPHEREx error; every star blended in the same pixel (within 6.2", up to 1.5 mag fainter) must agree. Tracks whose passes fall on different static stars are static. Partial matches, chance matches (p > 0.05) and in-between motions are ambiguous.

residual_median: median |SPHEREx - Gaia| PM (arcsec/yr); residual_mad: robust std (1.4826 x MAD) of one residual component; pull = residual / sqrt(spherex_pm_err^2 + gaia_pm_err^2) per component; pull_std is the plain std, pull_robust_std ignores outliers. They use the clean rows only: the Gaia star is in every pass, no blend, not a chance match.

Confusion counts tracked objects with truth real_mover or static: tp = engine mover and real, fp = engine mover but Gaia-static, fn = real but not flagged, tn = static, not flagged. false_mover_rate = fp / (fp + tn); recovered_fraction = tp / (tp + fn). Gaia stars faster than 0.5"/yr with G <= 18.0 inside the frames that no track saw (as its star, a blend or a pass's star) are listed in untracked_gaia_movers; recovered_fraction_incl_untracked counts them as misses (without the 3-sigma condition, which needs a SPHEREx error).
A Gaia star matched by several tracks with no pass in common is split_track: the engine cut one object's passes into pieces (n_stars_split_into_tracks).

objects and unmatched rows are compacted: the docs/RESULTS.md fields are always there; other fields are left out when null, false or empty, motion_decided_by when 'spherex', n_tracks_same_star when 1, gaia_related_ids when only the matched star; snr_band, totals and per-pass positions are in engine_movers and false_movers only.

motion_verdict is the website's per-object verdict (planetx.classify.reliability.field_verdicts) from SPHEREx alone (no archive, no catalogue check, so Gaia does not inform it); summary.verdict_vs_truth counts each verdict by Gaia truth.
Engine motions are relative to the field's stars (frames are aligned on them); summary.frame_pm_offset is the median residual of the clean static stars.
Engine movers are candidates to check, never confirmed objects.
